business_or_user_outcome: Operators can trust the product surface to expose engine power without forcing unnecessary manual triage.
change_intent: Prove the optional target repo product cohesion gate can pass with real journey evidence references.

claim_ceiling.rationale: This target fixture proves optional audit semantics, not real product readiness.
supported: product cohesion receipt shape is present for the target fixture
withheld: fixture does not claim live production UX quality

human_attention_policy.automation_expectation: The harness should route, retry, collect proof, and escalate internally before asking the user.
human_attention_policy.overuse_risk: If most issues land in Needs You, the product has failed the harness vision even if the engine remains correct.

primary_journey.end: User sees route, run evidence, claim ceiling, and any justified human-attention request.

steps.engine_truth: The route is backed by the same workflow decision used at execution time.
steps.system_response: Shows route preview and whether human attention is expected.

steps.engine_truth: Runtime evidence and UI state agree about route outcome and unresolved work.
steps.system_response: Shows claim ceiling, proof owed, receipts, and no unearned Needs You escalation.

product_promise: The product presents one coherent journey from issue intake through evidence without overusing human escalation.

surface_map.role: Turns user intent into a visible route and expected automation path.
Connects engine evidence, claim ceiling, and human-attention status.

user_job: Understand what the product will do, why it chose that route, and when it truly needs human attention.
